description: Kabo Codex plugin lifecycle hook. SessionStart only. The Codex host parses hook handlers as one of command | prompt | agent; the former mcp_tool subagent-telemetry hooks were never a variant it knew, and their presence made this whole file unparseable - which silently disabled SessionStart, i.e. skill sync and revocations (real incident, 2026-08-18). Usage telemetry is therefore not collected on the Codex variant until the host offers an MCP-capable hook type; the platform records tool-level telemetry server-side and treats client usage events as optional. Since 2026-09-03 that also covers skill-verify failures: this variant holds no credential of its own, so it cannot relay them the way the Claude variant does (kabo-headers --relay), and the injected-prompt relay it used to depend on asked the model to act on injected instructions - it stopped collecting them instead. The KABO_VERIFY_FAIL line on stderr is the local signal.
